targetTexts.1: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
targetTexts.2: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
targetTexts.3: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
targetTexts.4: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
targetTexts.5: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
targetTexts.6: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
targetTexts.7: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
targetTexts.8: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
targetTexts.9: unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
targetTexts.10: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
targetTexts.11: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
targetTexts.12: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
targetTexts.13: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.
targetTexts.14: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
targetTexts.15: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
targetTexts.16: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
targetTexts.17: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
targetTexts.18: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
